description:
**Divergence** — Dependencies / Restrictions table rows past line 21 of each extension-server AGENTS.md:
- crate-jmap-mail-server/AGENTS.md L127, L142 — rich list with runtime-vs-dev distinctions, citations to e.g. mime-tree-as-RFC-5322-gateway with `bd:JMAP-g7wu.11`
- crate-jmap-chat-server/AGENTS.md L156, L172 — adds `subtle` and `getrandom` with constant-time-compare design constraint
- crate-jmap-calendars-server/AGENTS.md L122, L137 — adds `thiserror` but no rationale (see bd:JMAP-ops7.46)
- crate-jmap-tasks-server/AGENTS.md L122, L137 — thin generic list
- crate-jmap-contacts-server/AGENTS.md L122, L137 — thin generic list
- crate-jmap-filenode-server/AGENTS.md L121, L136 — thin generic list
- crate-jmap-sharing-server/AGENTS.md L121, L136 — thin generic list
- crate-jmap-metadata-server/AGENTS.md L122, L137 — thin generic list

**Caller-observable cost**: a contributor adding a new dep to (e.g.) calendars-server has no guidance on whether to follow the chat-server constant-time-compare convention, or whether the workspace tolerates `thiserror` (yes per calendars-server, no per mail-server's "No thiserror" line — see bd:JMAP-ops7.46). The cookie-cutter siblings' thin rows treat dep policy as an oral tradition.

**Fix**: cookie-cut a richer Dependencies row from mail-server canonical into the 7 siblings, with per-sibling cross-references to crate-specific exceptions (e.g. chat-server's `subtle`+`getrandom`, calendars-server's `thiserror` — assuming bd:JMAP-ops7.46 resolves in favor of keeping it). Pure doc sweep, no code change.
title: 7 sibling extension-server AGENTS.md Dependencies rows are thin (generic dep list, no rationale); canonical mail-server's row is rich with runtime-vs-dev distinctions and citations — content past L21 drift
